notes.title: V131
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where units would step too far into impassable territory
[*] Adjustments to missions 2, 5 and 7
[/list]

notes.title: V130.2
notes.content:
[h2]Added new buttons next to the minimap![/h2]
[list]
[*] Focus King
[*] Select All Army (F2)
[*] Select All Spawners (F3)
[*] Open Menu (F10)
[/list]The buttons for F2/F3 also show the respective amount of available units.

[h2]Further improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated to SDL3
[*] Should more reliably catch certain GPU errors
[*] Can now change mouse confinement setting while the game is running
[/list]

notes.title: V130 - CLOUDY
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a visibility calculation bug
[*] Hostile units no longer cast fog of war behind them
[*] Air units can once again not look inside Clouds
[*] Added Coven to Missions 1 and 2
[/list]

notes.title: HOTFIX
notes.content:
Fix two panics:
[list]
[*] "argument of integer logarithm must be positive"
[*] "Uniform::new called with `low >= high`"
[/list]

Also fix issues in missions 3 and 10.

notes.title: V129
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Some fixes and improvements to missions
[*] Fix Jugglernaut not hitting certain enemies well
[*] Leaderboards are now cross-patch
[*] Leaderboard submissions should more quickly show up in the displayed ranking
[/list]
